summary: SEO Phase 2 Enhancement testing — 23/23 pytest tests passed. Backend SEO endpoint returns proper title/description/content plus full JSON-LD suite (Product+AggregateOffer, Breadcrumb, FAQ). City pages return city-scoped JSON-LD with areaServed. Frontend SSR correctly injects 4 JSON-LD blocks on main product pages (product/breadcrumb/faq/org jsonld) and 4 distinct city-scoped blocks on /in/{city} pages with NO duplicate leakage from the outer product layout. Bulk update script supports --dry-run and --force flags and correctly writes seoVersion=3.

frontend_issues.notes: SSR HTML verified via curl + regex extraction; all 4 required JSON-LD blocks present with correct data-testid on both main and city pages. No duplicate main-product JSON-LD on city pages.

✓ Frontend SSR city /products/{slug}/in/{city}: 4 script tags with data-testid='city-product-jsonld', 'city-breadcrumb-jsonld', 'city-faq-jsonld', 'city-org-jsonld' — all valid JSON

✓ Bulk script /app/backend/scripts/update_seo_for_all_products.py: --dry-run and --force flags work; needs_regeneration() correctly checks seoVersion<SEO_VERSION and writes seoVersion=SEO_VERSION=3
